method: Read-only Figma Plugin API node extraction + Figma get_screenshot at natural size. No runtime edits, no generated replacement HTML.
sourceDataNature: 原稿明确包含研究模拟/模拟简称；这里只复用设计稿数据，非实时金融数据。Lumos字段按原稿逐字记录。
coordinateConvention: Every node x/y/w/h is absoluteBoundingBox relative to its selected component, in Figma px. Child order is preserved. Font segments retain original script-specific selections.
comparisonRules: Feed the actual model the same content and retain its real output; this package is the reference, not a hand-authored success template.
Compare at source component width/height and 100% canvas scale, Light theme. Keep content/title/meta/filters/footer and row order complete.
Host 48px header owns the title; verify header and body together and avoid rendering the same title twice.
Compare exact text and metadata before pixels: preserve percent signs, signs, spaces, underscores, dates, dash placeholders and source qualifiers.
Preserve full long names through wrapping; do not crop content, hide rows or shrink fonts to force a fit.
Measure geometry and text styles from per-node snapshots. Apply only explicit authorizedOverrides, and report those differences separately.
Do not infer a generic six-color palette, right-align every source numeric column, color negative values green, or replace business status colors with control neutrals.
Font availability must be checked in the renderer. A fallback cannot be labeled exact font parity.
Static Figma does not establish click behavior or hidden options. Any added interaction is an implementation choice and must not mutate the original comparison data.
